status: runner implemented (scripts/integration/joint_campaign.py); pilot required before the official run
predecessor_design: joint-protocol-compact-v2.json (same 2x2 matrix, concurrency, repetitions and cold-image profile)
scope: Original Nova boots CirrOS servers with Placement and Glance in a 2x2 design (Python/Go each)
order: per repetition the four variants in a seeded random order; inside a variant the concurrencies in a seeded random order
variant_switch: Apache routes via placement_switch/glance_switch with rollback lease; nova-compute and nova-scheduler restarted on every variant change, then Nova schedulable and the compute provider inventory visible in the active Placement before the first block
image: DevStack CirrOS 0.6.3 x86_64 qcow2 (/opt/stack/devstack/files), size and SHA-256 recorded in the manifest
cold_image: every boot uses its own new image uploaded through the active Glance before the window; Nova's base cache entry sha1(image_id) must be absent before and present after the boot, and the active Glance must serve GET /v2/images/{id}/file 200 inside the window
service_traces: active implementation of each service must show the Nova calls inside the window (Placement: allocation_candidates 200 and PUT allocations 204 per server; Glance: file download 200 per image); a Go unit that is not active must show zero requests in the window and an original unit behind a Go route must be stopped
metrics: seconds from POST /servers to ACTIVE per server (1 s polling, +-1 s)
block makespan from the barrier to the last ACTIVE and boots per minute
Placement and Glance request counts and server-side latency inside the window
CPU seconds and peak PSS per cgroup (Placement, Glance, Nova services, Keystone, MySQL, Apache, Placement Go MySQL) over the window
VM busy CPU over the window
acceptance: All blocks valid: every server ACTIVE within the timeout, allocations equal to the flavor in the active Placement, cold transfer proven, correct service traces, servers/allocations/images/base-cache entries removed, original services and routes restored, lab identity and Go runtimes retired
statistics: Three paired repetitions per cell; publish every boot, the median and range per cell and Go/Python ratios per repetition; no tail percentiles or significance claims
